name: Cyril Callister Foundation Scholarship (SCU Science)
summary: $1,000 for a Northern Rivers resident studying a Bachelor of Science at SCU Lismore, Coffs Harbour or online.
who: Enrolled in a Bachelor of Science at Lismore, Coffs Harbour (National Marine Science Centre) or online.
